text: A bumblebee's wings beat 200 times a second. How many times do they beat in one minute?
A pipistrelle bat can eat 3,000 insects in one night. How many could it eat in a week?
Spell out all seven days of the week. How many letters is that altogether?
why: Monday 6, Tuesday 7, Wednesday 9, Thursday 8, Friday 6, Saturday 8, Sunday 6: 50.

text: Which day of the week has a letter D in its name that isn't part of the DAY at the end?
why: WeDnesday: the only D outside the final DAY.

text: In a room there are some cats and some people. Altogether there are 13 heads and 38 legs. How many cats are there?
why: If all 13 were people that's 26 legs; the 12 extra legs come from cats with two more each: 6 cats.
